headline: Profit climbs while per-share earnings slip year-over-year
summary_short: Huntington Bancshares reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of $0.34, down 2.9% y/y but up 30.8% q/q, as net income rose 35.6% y/y to $727 million.
summary_long: Basic EPS of $0.34 fell 2.9% y/y from $0.35 but rose 30.8% q/q from $0.26. Diluted EPS of $0.33 shows the same pattern, down 2.9% y/y and up 32.0% q/q. Net income of $727 million rose 35.6% y/y and 39.0% q/q. Revenue's prior-period shard values ($472M, $377M) appear to use a different basis than the current $2.837B figure and are omitted from comparison.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. This run used force-regenerate mode per explicit request; no summary file previously existed on disk for this ticker/period, so this is a first-time write rather than a true overwrite. The event's shard sourceLink (8-K dated 2026-06-25) resolved via scripts/resolve-edgar-exhibit.mjs to EX-99.1, which turned out to be a preferred-stock (Series I) dividend declaration, not an earnings release. Falling through to the EDGAR 10-Q filed 2026-07-28 (accession 0000049196-26-000066) found no press-release exhibit in that filing and a ~9.8MB main 10-Q document, beyond the run's fetch budget — hence the kpi-only downgrade. Revenue's q/q/y/y shard priors ($472M, $377M; SEC EDGAR RevenueFromContractWithCustomer tag) look like a materially narrower basis (likely noninterest income only) than the current period's $2.837B (Yahoo fundamentals-timeseries, likely total revenue including net interest income) — no revenue delta is reported to avoid a misleading number.
